veil.homeScreenNote: Safari leaves full screen when you swipe down. To play full screen, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

notes: Approved by Jeremy 2026-10-03. Shown on the veil above the full-screen button, only in iPad Safari outside a Home Screen launch. Safari's full screen exits on any downward swipe and no page can stop it; a Home Screen launch fills the screen without that gesture. The full-screen button itself is unchanged.
